name: entrust
description: Run Codex as a subagent from Claude Code: rights declared per call, the network on by default at both levels and off by one line, exit codes derived from evidence, a receipt per completed turn. Adds an orchestration mode over Claude and Codex agents, an approved cleanup, an experiment mode that keeps its protocol and verdicts on record, a standing advisor, a swarm launcher and a feedback mode that turns your own sessions into a report on a plugin.
